name: Makeup
description: Guidelines for traveling with makeup in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Liquid, gel, or cream makeup (mascara, liquid foundation, concealer) must be 3.4 oz or less. Solid, powder, or pressed makeup has no restrictions.

checkedBag.reason: All makeup and cosmetics are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring makeup on a plane?

travelTips: Liquid, gel, or cream makeup (mascara, liquid foundation, concealer) must be 3.4 oz or less. Solid, powder, or pressed makeup has no restrictions.

faq.question: Is makeup allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Makeup is restricted in carry-on luggage. Liquid, gel, or cream makeup (mascara, liquid foundation, concealer) must be 3.4 oz or less. Solid, powder, or pressed makeup has no restrictions.

faq.question: Can you pack makeup in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Makeup is allowed in checked bags. All makeup and cosmetics are allowed in checked baggage.
